files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: From weather_hourly.csv, compute the daily average of temp_c for each day of September 2025 (ignoring empty values), then a 3-day rolling average of those daily values that uses the day itself and the two days before. `result` should be a Series indexed by date in time order, rounded to 2 decimals, empty for 1 and 2 September.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv; daily mean of non-empty temp_c for each day of September 2025; then the mean over a 3-day window ending on each day (the day and the two before), missing for 1 and 2 September; a Series indexed by date in time order, rounded to 2 decimals.

acceptable_variants.notes: the index may be dates, timestamps at midnight, or YYYY-MM-DD text
